ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a schematic diagram of a topographic profile near 40°N. The horizontal axis is marked 100°E, 110°E, 120°E, and longitude increases to the right; the right side of the figure is labeled “ocean,” indicating that the right side is the eastern ocean direction, and the left side is the inland, western direction. The “leftward wind” arrow asked about in the figure indicates that air blows from the ocean side on the right to the continental side on the left. Reasoning: Wind direction is named according to the direction from which the wind blows. When this leftward airflow prevails, it is the summer monsoon blowing from the eastern ocean toward the North China interior; its source direction is mainly the southeast direction, so its wind direction is a southeast wind.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the schematic diagram of a topographic profile near 40°N.

<image1>

When the leftward wind in the figure is prevailing, what is the wind direction?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the horizontal axis is a 40°N terrain section, with longitudes increasing to the right and the ocean on the right, so right means east and left means west. The questioned arrow points left, indicating air moving from the eastern ocean side toward the continent. Since wind direction is named by the direction of origin, and the onshore monsoon reaching North China comes from the southeast, conclude that the leftward wind is a southeast wind.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：该图是40°N附近的地形剖面示意图，横轴标有100°E、110°E、120°E，经度向右增大；图的右侧标注“海洋”，说明右侧为东部海洋方向，左侧为内陆、西部方向。图中所问的“向左的风”箭头表示空气从右侧海洋一侧吹向左侧大陆一侧。推理：风向按风吹来的方向命名。该向左气流在盛行时是由东部海洋吹向华北内陆的夏季风，其来源方向主要为东南方向，因此其风向为东南风。
